	is_triggered_only = yes

	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_saf_beitbridge_signed
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_offer_saf_beitbridge_open
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_saf_beitbridge_ZIM } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_saf_beitbridge_ZIM }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_saf_beitbridge_onetime_done } }
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_saf_beitbridge_onetime_done
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.005 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				if = {
					limit = { owns_state = 289 controls_state = 289 }
					289 = {
						add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
						add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
					}
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
				mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes
				mdcw_cw_update_world_market = yes
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_RHO_BILAT.101.a
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Event COLDWAR_RHO_BILAT.101 option a"
		effect_tooltip = {
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_saf_beitbridge_ZIM

country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_RHO_BILAT.104
	title = COLDWAR_RHO_BILAT.104.t
	desc = COLDWAR_RHO_BILAT.104.d
	picture = GFX_COLDWAR_CUB_1970_event_signing
	is_triggered_only = yes

	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_eng_settlement_signed
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_offer_eng_settlement_open
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_eng_settlement_ZIM } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_eng_settlement_ZIM }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_eng_settlement_onetime_done } }
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_eng_settlement_onetime_done
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.004 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes

			}
			if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_un_mandatory_sanctions } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_un_mandatory_sanctions }
			if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_clandestine_sanctions_busting } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_clandestine_sanctions_busting }
			if = {
				limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_unrecognized_udi_state }
				swap_ideas = {
					remove_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_unrecognized_udi_state
					add_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_transitional_constitutional_safeguards
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_unrecognized_republic }
				swap_ideas = {
					remove_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_unrecognized_republic
					add_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_transitional_constitutional_safeguards
				}
			}
			COLDWAR_RHO_FLV_cancel_por_alcora = yes
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_RHO_EVT.5 days = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
				mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes
				mdcw_cw_update_world_market = yes
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_RHO_BILAT.104.a
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Event COLDWAR_RHO_BILAT.104 option a"
		effect_tooltip = {
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_eng_settlement_ZIM
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_eng_settlement_zim_wk_tt
		}
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_RHO_BILAT.110
	title = COLDWAR_RHO_BILAT.110.t
	desc = COLDWAR_RHO_BILAT.110.d
	picture = GFX_COLDWAR_CUB_1970_event_signing
	is_triggered_only = yes

	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_chi_zanla_signed
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_offer_chi_zanla_open
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_chi_zanla_ZIM } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_chi_zanla_ZIM }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_chi_zanla_onetime_done } }
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_chi_zanla_onetime_done
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.003 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				if = {
					limit = { owns_state = 290 controls_state = 290 }
					290 = {
						add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
						add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes }
					}
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
				mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes
				mdcw_cw_update_world_market = yes
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_RHO_BILAT.110.a
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Event COLDWAR_RHO_BILAT.110 option a"
		effect_tooltip = {
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_chi_zanla_ZIM
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_chi_zanla_zim_wk_tt
		}
	}
}
